parts.name: base frame

physics.Basic_description: The thin red-outlined structural rim and spine of the clear plastic CD case.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid outer boundary and hinge mechanism for the case assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the spine or outer edge firmly to hold the case structure stable.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic shell with thin walls enclosing air.

parts.description: The thin red-outlined structural rim and spine of the clear plastic CD case.

parts.name: sleeve pocket

physics.Basic_description: The green-colored inner tray or booklet pocket area inside the case base.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the liner notes or secures the disc hub within the case base.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp target; usually covered by the lid or disc.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic insert designed to fit inside the frame.

parts.name: disc body

physics.Basic_description: The blue circular optical disc seated in the center of the tray.
physics.Functional_description: Stores digital audio or data content readable by a laser.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp carefully by the outer edge or center hole to avoid surface damage.
physics.reason: A standard CD is a solid 1.2mm thick polycarbonate substrate.

parts.name: lid shell

physics.Basic_description: The large yellow-highlighted transparent front cover of the jewel case.

physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the free edge opposite the hinge to lift and open the case.
physics.reason: Thin injection-molded plastic shell, hollow interior.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
